place: Squamish Valley Golf Club, 2458 Mamquam Road
preview: This is the first meeting of the newly elected council. Mayor Easton and six councillors will be sworn in, council will choose who sits on outside boards and who acts as mayor each month, and it will set its 2027 meeting dates.

agenda_items.plain: Mayor Sean Easton and Councillors Andersen, DesJardins, Ellis, Perreault, Prosko and Veltkamp will take their oaths of office, led by a judge, after a Squamish Nation blessing.
Mayor Easton will give his first speech to the community, and each councillor will share remarks.

Council will vote on who represents Squamish on the Squamish-Lillooet Regional District Board (the regional government that covers Squamish and nearby areas): Mayor Easton with 5 votes, and Councillors Ellis and Andersen with 4 votes each.
agenda_items.for_you: Councillors Prosko, Perreault and Veltkamp would fill in as backups when a main member cannot attend.

agenda_items.plain: Council will vote on approving its 2027 meeting schedule, with regular business meetings at 6 p.m. at Municipal Hall on Second Avenue.
agenda_items.for_you: Regular meetings would be held twice most months, with one in September and none in August.

agenda_items.plain: Council will vote on a rotating list of councillors who step in as acting mayor each month from November 2026 to December 2027.
Council will vote on naming Councillors Andersen, Prosko and Veltkamp to the Land Back Task Force until the end of 2027.
Council will vote on naming Councillors Ellis and Perreault to the Community Forest Board until the end of 2027.
Council will vote on naming Councillor DesJardins to the Squamish Library Board until the end of 2027.
The mayor and each councillor may invite one community member to speak to council for up to three minutes.
agenda_items.for_you: The meeting is at the Squamish Valley Golf Club on Mamquam Road at 6 p.m., followed by a community welcome and reception.
